{"id":1957574276,"question_id":3031,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 4 weeks","timestamp":1774341896,"status":15,"status_display":"Runtime Error","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1957574276/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Construct Product Matrix","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    int mod = 12345;\n\n    vector<vector<int>> constructProductMatrix(vector<vector<int>>& grid) {\n        int n = grid.size();\n        int m = grid[0].size();\n\n        vector<vector<int>>ans(n , vector<int>(m , 0));\n\n        ll prod = 1;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0 ; j<m ; j++)\n            {\n                prod *= grid[i][j];\n            }\n        }\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0 ; j<m ; j++)\n            {\n                ans[i][j] = (prod / grid[i][j]) % mod;\n            }\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"construct-product-matrix","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1856}
